answer: An invitation is only renewed when the invited identity has produced work that a stranger attested, so waiting out a quarantine window is worthless and only per-identity attested work ages an account into the trusted tier. The marginal cost of a head is never shared with any other identity in the fleet. The tide is the attested output, the reef the stranger who checks it, and the oasis the tier the pair unlocks; the tide is per identity, the reef cannot be the farm's own, and the oasis is what waiting alone cannot buy.
